I got this title inspiration from this Tweet 🐥 🤷‍♂️ https://x.com/UnslothAI/status/2092639558815060281?s=20

In this video, we take a deep dive into Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, explore its architecture, and run the model locally using Unsloth GGUF + llama.cpp on Apple Silicon.

We’ll look at how a model with 125B total parameters and approximately 6B activated parameters works, including its 512-expert MoE architecture, Gated DeltaNet, Qwen Sparse Attention, Gated Residual, N-gram Embeddings, and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP).

Chapters:
00:00 - Introduction
01:54 - Additional 51B Embedding Parameters
05:02 - Setting up Llama.cpp to run the 1Bit Quant Model
09:42 - Running 4-Bit Quant QWEN3.8Flash-Next Model
